harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, persistently disabled IPv4 acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packets (accept_source_route) by writing /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf covering all, default, lo, and enp1s0 scopes, applied live via `sysctl --system`, and verified the settings survive a full node reboot (new boot_id, uptime 0 min).
actions_performed: Captured baseline sysctl values and boot_id on node1 (cmd-b792edcd620d4ac9)
Wrote /etc/sysctl.d/60-disable-icmp-redirects-source-route.conf setting accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default/lo/enp1s0 (cmd-562570159f544558)
Applied config with sysctl --system, confirming live application (cmd-68e18fc5234f42e0)
Verified live /proc/sys values are 0 across all interfaces (cmd-ee9686be358a4be0)
Issued reboot via shutdown -r now, capturing pre-reboot boot_id (cmd-e2e1d644fdf4489a)
Polled node1 until reachable again, confirming new boot_id and uptime 0 min (cmd-0a8f0d7df6f14826)
Re-verified sysctl values and config file contents post-reboot, confirming persistence (cmd-c81a2ae01d514600)

evidence.requirement: Disable acceptance of ICMP redirects (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) for IPv4 persistently
evidence.summary: Baseline showed accept_redirects=1/secure_redirects=1; new /etc/sysctl.d config set both to 0 for all interfaces, applied live, and confirmed 0 both immediately and after reboot

evidence.requirement: Disable acceptance of source-routed packets (accept_source_route) for IPv4 persistently
evidence.summary: accept_source_route explicitly pinned to 0 in persistent config for all/default/lo/enp1s0 and confirmed 0 before and after reboot

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart evidence protocol: boot identity change, service/config recovery
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 739c9792... before reboot, issued shutdown -r now, polled until node1 responded with new boot_id 0ae6621f... and uptime 0 min, then verified the hardening sysctl settings and config file survived the restart
